ABOUT US

Freshly backed by some of the top VCs in Silicon Valley, Trener is redefining robotics by combining advanced AI for intuitive programming with pre-trained skill models that are experts at industrial tasks. With offices in San Francisco (USA) and Trondheim (Norway), we provide software that gives our users unprecedented ease-of-use and capabilities for their robots, allowing them to think, adapt, and perform complex tasks like any skilled worker.



ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Field-Focused Integration Engineer to join our robotics team and lead the deployment of our robotic systems in real-world industrial environments. You will be responsible for hands-on installation, commissioning, and integration of robotic cells in production facilities, ensuring our systems meet safety standards and customer requirements while delivering exceptional performance.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead on-site installation and commissioning of robotic systems in customer facilities

 - Design and implement integration strategies for industrial robotic cells including manipulators, safety systems, and auxiliary equipment

 - Conduct system validation, safety assessments, and performance optimization in production environments

 - Ensure compliance with industrial safety standards and electrical codes

 -  Provide hands-on customer support, training, and field troubleshooting services

 - Collaborate with customers to understand production requirements and adapt solutions accordingly

 - Develop deployment documentation, risk assessments, and standard operating procedures

 - Drive continuous improvement of field integration processes and best practices

 - Perform Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) to validate system performance


REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

 - 3+ years of hands-on industrial robotics integration and deployment experience

 - Proven experience integrating robots in real production environments (academic/lab-only experience is not sufficient unless accompanied by significant industrial compliance experience)

 - Experience with 6-DOF robot arms from major manufacturers (ABB, KUKA, Fanuc, Universal Robots, or similar)

 - Strong knowledge of electrical and safety standards (ISO 10218, ANSI/RIA R15.06, NFPA 79, NEC, CE marking)

 - Experience with industrial PLCs, electrical panel design, and control systems

 - Proficiency in CAD software for layout design and integration planning

 - Understanding of motor control, servo systems, and industrial communication protocols

 - Ability to read and create electrical schematics and P&IDs

 - Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer deployments

 - Excellent communication skills and customer-facing experience

 - Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites


WHAT WILL DIFFERENTIATE YOU

 - Master's degree in relevant engineering discipline

 - Professional certifications in robotics safety, electrical systems, or industrial automation (e.g., Certified Automation Professional, CSP, RIA, OSHA certifications)

 - Experience with specific industry verticals (automotive, manufacturing, electronics, logistics)

 - Knowledge of machine vision integration and CNC machinery

 - Experience with risk assessments and safety circuit design

 - A proactive, self-starting mentality with excellent problem-solving skills and the resilience to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A unique opportunity to work at the forefront of robotics and AI

 - A central role in a growing startup where your contributions will directly shape our future

 - Competitive salary, employee equity, and bonuses

 - A dynamic and international work environment with offices in the US and Norway
